title: [01/03/2023] Changes in a student accommodation
prompt: The diagrams give information about changes in a student accommodation. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The two diagrams illustrate the modifications made to a student accommodation, comparing its layout in 2010 with the current arrangement.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, substantial changes have occurred to the exterior, with most of the southern garden area being replaced by a car parking facility, while a cluster of gardens in the north has been relocated. Internally, the most significant modification is the increase in bedroom capacity from three to five units.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the exterior changes, the most notable transformation is the replacement of the southern garden area with a car parking facility. Additionally, while some garden spaces have been preserved along the northern perimeter, one cluster has been moved to a different position. The main entrance, however, maintains its original location on the left side of the building.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the interior layout, the most substantial change is the conversion of the living room into two student bedrooms, increasing the total number from three to five. An en-suite room has also been added to the hallway area. Meanwhile, the kitchen retains its position in the right section of the building, and the bathroom remains adjacent to the hallway, both keeping their original sizes and locations.
